summary: First iteration for OrthoVault MVP. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (health, upload/download image+PDF via Emergent Object Storage, 404 for missing file, patient CRUD+upsert without duplicates, media array persistence, ObjectId leakage check, 404 on missing/double-delete). Frontend: full mobile flow works – setup-pin -> dashboard, add-patient form saves and card appears, search filters, 13 sort chips render, patient detail loads with all 5 tabs (Info/History/Compare/Results/Video), Settings shows all 3 theme toggles, reload with existing PIN routes to /auth and PIN unlocks to dashboard.

issues: Console emits repeated 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings from RN Web – cosmetic only, not blocking.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web console warnings.

Optional: /auth screen auto-submits when PIN length hits 6 in onChange – the auth-submit-button is effectively decorative in the happy path. Consider gating auto-submit behind an explicit tap for clarity, or document this in test guidance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {"_id": 0} – good.
Object storage init has 503 retry with key refresh – good resilience.
Upsert path preserves created_at from existing doc – correct.
All routes prefixed with /api and Pydantic-validated – good.
app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler in future refactor (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates 'TEST_*' prefixed patients and cleans them up in teardown. UI test created one 'TEST_UI_Patient' via the Add-Patient form which remains in DB (safe – prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://surgical-vault-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Frontend var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Web PIN persists in localStorage; clear it before re-running setup-pin flow. /auth auto-submits PIN when 6 digits are typed, do NOT rely on clicking auth-submit-button after fill – either avoid the fill (send 5 digits + click) or just accept auto-navigation.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bugs found. Initial script failure on auth-submit-button click was a test-timing artifact caused by /auth's auto-submit-on-6th-digit; the app itself unlocks correctly.
